boundaryGate.question: After Alembic af4d976, does the real BiliDili P10 project-index workflow-unify route either fail-closed on corrupt fullReset before generation or, if reset succeeds, produce non-empty target-scoped host/in-process coverage with empty parity diff?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili workspace only, using configured Alembic/AlembicPlugin/AlembicCore/BiliDili local sources and existing DeepSeek generation plus local Qwen embedding provider setup.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller reviewed and accepted Alembic af4d976 source repair against live route files.
Controller replayed Alembic targeted unit tests, biome changed-file check, build:check, repo-boundary, diff-check, and lint exit 0.
Wakeflow runtime verification passed after creating the Test rerun package, with only existing non-blocking runtime allow-list warning.
realScenarioConditions: Use direct real BiliDili workspace; no sandbox copy.
Run R-2 cleanup.projectRoot/dataRoot ternary proof before destructive reset.
Use alembic_bootstrap({rebuild:true}) as the reset entry between routes.
Keep provider/source configuration unchanged: DeepSeek generation and local Qwen embedding.
successMeans: If DB/table clear is corrupt, bootstrap stops before Recipe generation and before fullReset success logs, with resetMode=fail-closed diagnostic and raw DB/log evidence.
If fullReset succeeds, stale DB rows, aggregate/root coverage rows, old bootstrap sessions, and open rounds are cleared or replaced.
Host and in-process ledgers/cells are non-empty and target scoped, coverageLedgerSeed is present, and host vs in-process parity diff is empty.
The pass is not 0-vs-0 empty parity.
failureMeans: BOOTSTRAP_IN_PROGRESS persists after a successful reset.
fullReset logs complete(errors>0) without fail-closed blocking.
Stale knowledge_entries, coverage_ledger, deep_mining_rounds, aggregate/root module ids, active sessions, or open rounds survive a successful reset.
Host/in-process parity diff remains non-empty or coverage ledger is empty.
cannotConclude: Cannot conclude P10 complete if only fail-closed corrupt DB behavior is demonstrated; that is accepted as source repair but leaves parity/G4 blocked by data reset health.
Cannot conclude G4/G6 or final demand completion from this single Test rerun unless all corresponding gates are explicitly evidenced.
Cannot treat empty host/in-process outputs as parity success.
stopConditions: R-2 root/dataRoot proof fails or source/provider pins mismatch.
Corrupt DB clear fails and fail-closed diagnostic is captured.
Any manual state mutation would be required to continue.
Real run threatens paths outside BiliDili data root.

evidenceRequired: Source pin summary for Alembic af4d976, AlembicPlugin aee228b, AlembicCore 99a7cf1, and BiliDili workspace commit/state.
Bootstrap/rebuild runtime JSON and logs, including fullReset/fail-closed/session evidence.
DB/coverage ledger summaries showing target scope and non-empty cells or fail-closed corrupt DB evidence.
Host vs in-process parity diff artifact and statement that it is not 0-vs-0.
TargetResultEnvelope with commands, outputs, risks, and next recommendation.
allowedOperations: Read BiliDili/Alembic runtime files and logs needed for evidence.
Run BiliDili real workspace bootstrap/rescan verification commands through the configured local Alembic route.
Collect runtime JSON, log excerpts, DB/ledger summaries, parity diff, and source pin evidence.
forbiddenOperations: Do not manually edit DB/session/provider/source state to create a pass.
Do not touch ~/.asd outside the BiliDili data root.
Do not change product code in Test.
